name: Cross-account application modification is denied by the server and owner data stays unchanged
description: Focused deterministic journey; explicit reusable Python assertions are stored alongside this authored plan. Isolated labelled fixtures only for source mutations.

planSteps.description: Sign in the configured student and save the real Twente scholarship. Record private application id, note and revision.
Use an independent authenticated context for VAR_{other_email} with VAR_{password}. Send an update for the first student application to the normal protected application API.
Assert the actual server responds404; another userId query cannot expose the first student application. Assert student access to /api/operator/discovery responds403.
Read the application again as its owner and assert original note and revision are unchanged. Do not infer access denial from a hidden button alone.
